answer.instruction: In app.py, fix the signup function to ensure that the raw phone number is never sent to external recipients (r2, r3). The phone number must be stripped from events before publishing to external recipients. Preserve all existing behavior including failure paths and event id/kind. Ensure public delivery functions also prevent external raw-phone disclosure when called directly. Specifically, fix the test failures by ensuring that external recipients (r2, r3) receive events without the phone field, and that failure paths do not leak the phone number. Also, ensure that the number of messages published to r2 is exactly one, and that failure diagnostics correctly count the number of external recipients.
